notes.content:
1. Optimize game difficulty, optimize enemy troop allocation, reduce later level difficulty, and optimize game running speed

3. Dong Bai has added a special skill called "Lady Bai", which has the effect of counterattacking after being attacked
4. Add the special skill "Four Friends of Cao Wei" and assign it to Sima Yi, Chen Qun, Zhu Shuo, and Wu Zhi respectively
5. Chen Qun added the special skill "Knowing People's Wisdom", with a magic defense of+20
6. Shia adds special skill Death Warrior, HP, speed, defense+10
7. Zhao increases his special skill "fellow townsman", lucky+10
